# Swiss Data Events

> Swiss Data Events (swissdataevents.ch) is a curated list of upcoming AI and data events in Switzerland: meetups, conferences, workshops, networking evenings and webinars about Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, the Azure data platform, AI strategy and governance, data governance, data leadership and applied AI. Every listing is checked against the organiser's own page before it is published, and the list is refreshed every day. Registration always happens on the organiser's site.

Last checked against sources: 2026-11-14T12:04:05Z. 136 upcoming events. All times are Europe/Zurich.

Each event has its own page on this site with the date, time, place, cost, organiser and a link to the organiser's registration page. Details can change on the organiser's side, so the organiser's page is the final word.

## Data

- [All upcoming events as JSON](https://swissdataevents.ch/events.json): one object per event with ISO 8601 start/end, city, format, topics, cost, organiser and links
- [RSS feed](https://swissdataevents.ch/rss.xml): upcoming events, newest listings first
- [Calendar feed (iCalendar)](https://swissdataevents.ch/calendar/all.ics): subscribe in Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar; per-city and per-format feeds are listed on the data page
- [About the data](https://swissdataevents.ch/data/): field descriptions and usage notes
